name: H1 Gallery
summary: Gallery of marketing headlines (H1s) from live websites, with a weekly email roundup of new picks.
description: A collection of marketing headlines spotted across the web, each shown with its company and a link to the live site; item pages break down why the headline works. Entries are numbered and added regularly, and a Friday email roundup covers three of them per week. Curated by Corey Haines.
contains: each entry: headline, company and link to the live site
item pages include a 'why this H1 works' analysis
weekly Friday email with three headlines
